question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] The logic followed here is: Option 1) PN - QO [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f493d8e4208b07747e7506ad9cc91306c7dff20f0d37e7cc6f6b0e4eca632f63.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a54063fbef68cc90b696e86493b2ff3947aa655f1a65a01e695366ec434c040f.png] Option 2) QO - RP
